title: Cover Flow
description: Twelve Beatles records on a black floor. Drag, scroll, scrub or use the arrow keys and the covers swing past on a capped-speed spring with their reflections; the album that lands in the middle rolls its title in letter by letter.
intent: The classic browser rebuilt as a modern component: one spring with a speed cap drives every cover, so a fling can be caught mid-flight and nothing races past faster than you can read it.
